baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence fa-a'radu / fa-arsalna and the construction sayl al-arim at words 1-5.
baseline_models.mechanism: Turning away is followed by dispatch of a current whose arim inventory includes both a flood-retaining embankment and an overpowering flood. The sequence therefore permits a containment reversal: what had held productive water becomes the means of inundation.

activation_trace.role: Turning one's side supplies the initiating withdrawal from the prior relation.
Release and dispatch supply the transition from refusal to a moving agency.
Running water supplies the mobile destructive medium.
The embankment that restrains an overpowering flood supplies the containment that is reversed.

changed_reading.before: They turn away and are then struck by an external flood.
changed_reading.after: Their withdrawal is answered by a reversal of containment, converting held and potentially productive flow into inundation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction baddalnahum bi-jannatayhim jannatayn repeats the dual garden noun across the exchange.
baseline_models.mechanism: Replacement occurs without erasing the garden category or its dual form. The shell persists while the internal yield changes, so the punishment is an identity-preserving degradation rather than simple annihilation.

activation_trace.role: One thing standing in another's place supplies literal exchange.
Change of form with continuity of the thing supplies internal transformation.
The repeated tree-covered garden image preserves the same named container on both sides.
Tree and crop yield locates the decisive change inside productivity.

changed_reading.before: The good gardens disappear and unrelated bad land replaces them.
changed_reading.after: The two gardens remain categorically and numerically recognizable, but their productive interior is exchanged.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The replacement still has ukul, followed by khamt, athl, and only a little sidr.
baseline_models.mechanism: The scene does not move from growth to absolute sterility. It recomposes output toward sourness, fixed woody persistence, and scarcity, producing an ecology that still grows while withholding former quality and abundance.

activation_trace.role: Yield confirms that the replacement remains productive.
Soured taste supplies qualitative degradation within what is produced.
A fixed gathered root supplies persistence without restoring former abundance.
Fewness makes the remaining desirable growth quantitatively marginal.

changed_reading.before: The replacement gardens are simply barren.
changed_reading.after: Growth persists, but useful edible output is soured, redirected toward woody persistence, and reduced to a scant remainder.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first balances what enters and exits the earth with what descends and ascends through the sky. That ordered circulation sharpens the focus flood into a punitive reversal inside a governed flow system, not an autonomous accident.

activation_trace.role: The focus current is the flow whose ordinary circuit is being re-read.
Retained versus overpowering water supplies the focus-side reversal.
Entry into an interior supplies one direction of the earth's circulation.
Passage outward supplies the paired return direction.
Descent supplies the downward atmospheric movement.
Ascent supplies its balancing upward movement.

structural_cues: 34:2 arranges ingress/egress and descent/ascent as balanced pairs before the focus event.
34:9 later places threatened collapse below and falling pieces above, showing that spatial order can become punitive.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired directional movements and the focus supplies released floodwater; I infer a regulated circuit whose containment is reversed. A live alternative is that 34:2 only asserts comprehensive knowledge without specifying hydrology.

changed_reading.before: The flood is a one-off destructive water event.
changed_reading.after: The flood is a controlled circulation turned against its beneficiaries when a boundary or holding relation is reversed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The contiguous craft sequence softens hard metal, proportions linked armor, makes molten copper flow, gathers capacity in basin-like vessels, and fixes large cauldrons. Sayl al-arim becomes the negative counterimage: mobilized matter no longer retained by proportion, linkage, vessel, or anchoring.

activation_trace.role: The flood-retaining embankment anchors the focus event in containment technology.
Softening against hardness shows commanded material change can be constructive.
Deliberate proportion supplies the control that makes linked material useful.
Connected succession supplies a stable linked structure rather than dispersal.
A second caused flow makes mobility itself neutral until its use and containment are specified.
Molten copper supplies beneficial commanded liquidity.
Collected water and basin imagery supplies receptacle and retained capacity.
Fixity supplies the anchoring pole opposed to released inundation.

structural_cues: 34:10-13 is a contiguous sequence immediately before the focus scene.
The sequence alternates softening, measure, connected construction, flow, receptacles, and fixity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the material operations and their order; I infer an engineering analogy between beneficially measured flow and destructive uncontained flow. The alternative is that these are adjacent gifts with no intended technical contrast.

changed_reading.before: The focus depicts uncontrolled water overwhelming gardens.
changed_reading.after: It depicts the destructive counterpart of the preceding measured material economy: flow becomes ruin when proportion, linkage, receptacle, and anchoring fail.

context_deltas.mechanism: Fewness first qualifies grateful servants; the next garden scene commands eating provision and gratitude; then turning away is followed by little remaining growth. The focus quantity now mirrors a prior human scarcity, shifting qilla from response to ecology.

activation_trace.role: Fewness first measures the human field of grateful response.
Sufficiency through a little and its visible effect links gratitude with productive response.
The flourishing garden pair supplies the provisioned setting before exchange.
Eating supplies the intended reception of the garden's provision.
Nourishing provision identifies the garden output as apportioned sustenance.
Recognition of beneficence supplies the requested human return.
Fewness reappears as the ecological remainder after turning away.

structural_cues: 34:13 moves from few grateful servants to 34:15's command to eat and be grateful.
34:16 answers the plural turning away with a product list ending in little.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical recurrence and sequence; I infer a feedback relation in which scarce acknowledgment is answered by scarce desirable yield. The live alternative is a moral-poetic correspondence rather than a direct ecological causal law.

changed_reading.before: Little merely counts one minor plant in the replacement gardens.
changed_reading.after: Little is a mirrored scarcity: few enact gratitude, and after refusal little desirable growth remains.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the garden account, hidden creeping consumption eats a support until a sudden fall discloses concealed ignorance. That sequence reopens eating as material erosion: the visible flood and exchange may culminate a prior, unseen weakening of the system that held abundance upright.

activation_trace.role: The retaining structure supplies the focus-side support that can fail.
Hidden creeping supplies an initially imperceptible process of weakening.
Eating as corrosion turns consumption into loss of material integrity.
A noisy unstable fall supplies the delayed visible threshold event.
Emergence into clarity makes collapse a disclosure as well as destruction.
The hidden beings supply the subjects whose claimed knowledge is exposed.
What is screened from sight supplies the concealed domain disproved by the fall.

structural_cues: 34:14 immediately precedes the two-garden account and stages slow consumption followed by sudden collapse.
The focus then moves from a retaining flood structure to exchanged garden productivity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one explicit support failure and one flood-linked exchange; I infer that the latter can be read through the former as disclosed systemic erosion. The live alternative is that the two collapses are independent neighboring examples.

changed_reading.before: An external flood abruptly causes an ecological swap.
changed_reading.after: The flood can mark the visible threshold of a support system already being consumed or weakened out of sight.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden pair at two flanks is followed by linked visible towns and measured safe passage, then by requested distance and complete tearing. The focus exchange can therefore target connective infrastructure: the named garden pair remains, but the relations joining water, yield, and accessible movement are fragmented.

activation_trace.role: Replacement supplies the local transformation of the garden system.
The pre-focus garden pair supplies productive nodes placed on opposing flanks.
A connection standing between endpoints supplies the route network's linkage.
Measured planning supplies usable spacing and predictable travel.
Passage and flow supply functioning movement through the linked settlements.
Producing distance reverses accessible adjacency.
Tearing into separated pieces supplies the terminal topology of broken connection.

structural_cues: 34:15 places the gardens to right and left; 34:18 repeats between while describing visible towns.
34:18 measures travel, whereas 34:19 requests distance and ends in total fragmentation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired productive places, linked routes, measured travel, and fragmentation; I infer that irrigation and travel share a connective-system logic. The alternative is that garden loss and route dispersal are parallel consequences without one infrastructural mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Two isolated fields are exchanged for inferior fields.
changed_reading.after: A connected abundance system loses continuity: its garden nodes remain named, but the water, yield, and access relations that made them useful are broken.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later uses of the sending root repeatedly concern a messenger or warning met by denial, especially from those released by luxury. The focus syntax, they turned away so We sent upon them, permits the released flood to function as a nonverbal dispatch carrying the warning materially.

activation_trace.role: Physical dispatch releases the flood as an agent upon them.
Messenger and carried message activate a communicative dimension in sending.
Repeated sending in a rejection scene ties dispatch to refused communication.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the message function.
Expansive luxury that releases its holder supplies the social posture resisting warning.
The absence of a prior messenger keeps sending and warning explicitly coupled.
The warning role clarifies what a communicative dispatch would carry.
Denied messengers make rejection followed by material consequence a recurring pattern.

structural_cues: 34:16 directly coordinates turning away with sending by two consecutive fa clauses.
34:28, 34:34, 34:44, and 34:45 repeatedly place sending in messenger and warning discourse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated sending root and refusal contexts; I infer that the flood can carry a material message. The live alternative is that the shared verb marks agency only and should not personify the event.

changed_reading.before: Sent only identifies who caused or released the flood.
changed_reading.after: The flood is also a material envoy: refused communication returns as an environmental message that cannot be turned away from.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later argument rejects numerical abundance as immunity and repeatedly opposes expanded provision to constricted provision, then promises that outflow is followed by replacement. The focus exchange is thus a regime change in apportioned sustenance, preserving provision's existence while altering its quantity, quality, and usability.

activation_trace.role: One provision form standing in another's place anchors the focus as reallocation.
An apportioned edible share makes the garden output a provision unit.
Growth in number supplies the boast that abundance guarantees security.
Expansion and increase supply one pole of provision governance.
An apportioned gift identifies what is expanded or constrained.
Constriction to a small measure supplies the opposite pole.
Money leaving in expenditure supplies a sanctioned outgoing flow.
A successor taking the prior thing's place supplies restorative replacement.

structural_cues: 34:35 claims greater wealth and children as insulation from punishment.
34:36 and 34:39 repeat the expansion/constriction formula, while 34:39 adds outgoing expenditure and replacement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies quantity, expansion, constriction, expenditure, and replacement; I infer a single provisioning regime that also governs the garden exchange. The alternative is that later economic language only generalizes divine power without specifying 34:16's ecology.

changed_reading.before: The exchange is a local crop punishment.
changed_reading.after: It is a controlled reallocation and constriction of sustenance that disproves abundance as permanent possession or immunity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ending makes nearness compatible with failed escape, contrasts reaching with distance, and finally inserts a barrier between people and what they desire. Because the focus preserves two gardens while changing their edible yield, its punishment can likewise be presence without access: the object remains near and named, but the relation of enjoyment is severed.

activation_trace.role: The repeated garden category keeps the desired object nominally present.
Yield locates access in what the nearby garden can actually provide.
Failure of attainment shows that spatial opportunity need not produce access.
Seizure reverses agency: they are reached even when they cannot reach safety.
Nearness supplies proximity without beneficial control.
Extending to attain something supplies the desired but unavailable relation.
Distance explains why belated reaching fails.
An intervening barrier explicitly severs subject from object.
The soul's movement toward the desired object identifies the blocked relation.

structural_cues: 34:51 combines a near place with no escape; 34:52 answers with attempted reaching from a distant place.
34:54 closes by placing an intervening barrier between subjects and their desires.
34:16 repeats the garden pair but changes what can be eaten from it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nearness, failed reaching, distance, barrier, and desire; I infer that the focus botanical exchange enacts the same access structure. The live alternative is that the ending echoes rather than interprets the earlier garden event.

changed_reading.before: Punishment removes the desired gardens and leaves bad vegetation elsewhere.
changed_reading.after: Punishment leaves the gardens present and close but cuts access to their desired quality, making possession without enjoyment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it depends on the packet's non-dominant mapping from focus root ء ك ل to mapped root ك ل ل rather than ordinary surface morphology. It remains anchored by the exact mapped target and is reinforced by contextual ك ل ل; downstream prose must present it only as a totality/scarcity echo, never as a direct gloss of ukul.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places ukul before qalil, and the packet maps the former not only to eating but also to the totalizing root inventory.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant image of totality and enclosure supplies a shadow of comprehensive yield.
Explicit fewness compresses that shadow of totality into a remainder.
Contextual totalizers around complete tearing and responsive endurance keep whole-versus-fragment pressure active.

changed_reading.before: Ukul names produce and qalil only limits the final plant.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, a shadow of comprehensive provision is compressed into little, intensifying the exchange from fullness to remainder.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The activation is surprising because khamt's agitation and wave-surge branch is distant from its plant use. It remains anchored in the exact focus word beside the flood and is supported by the same root's sour-taste branch; downstream prose should qualify it as a lexical undertone, not identify the plant with a storm.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Khamt occurs inside the replacement yield immediately after sayl al-arim.

activation_trace.role: The running flood supplies the catastrophe's motion.
Agitation, charging force, and colliding sea waves carry that motion into the product list.
Soured liquid supplies a changed taste through which catastrophe remains consumable.

changed_reading.before: The flood ends, and khamt is merely one replacement plant.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the replacement fruit retains the flood's agitation and sourness, so the catastrophe persists inside what the garden now yields.

strongest_changes: The arim branch turns the event from an unstructured deluge into a reversal of water containment.
The preceding craft sequence makes destructive floodwater the counterimage of measured, linked, contained material flow.
The sequence from few grateful servants to eating provision to little remaining growth creates a gratitude-yield feedback reading.
The ending recasts the preserved garden pair as proximity without access to desired quality.
Repeated messenger uses let the physically dispatched flood carry a contained material-message reading.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context changed an isolated flood-and-crop punishment into a coordinated failure of containment, measure, connectivity, provisioning, communication, and access while the garden shell remains visibly in place.
remaining_uncertainties: Arim can foreground the retaining embankment or simply the overpowering flood; the containment reversal depends on carrying both packet images together.
The hidden-erosion and infrastructure models infer causal continuity from neighboring sequences that may instead be parallel examples.
The whole-to-little and catastrophe-in-fruit outliers rely on form-distant branches and must remain exploratory lexical echoes.
